method: Targeted web search of claims already present; not a systematic database review. Local metadata REST requests and acquisition routes are recorded separately.
queries: Verhulst 2022 glycaemic thresholds counterregulatory 3.4 3.8 type 1 diabetes systematic review
Somogyi type 1 diabetes 2025 post hypoglycemic nocturnal hyperglycemia 755 CGM
Donga 2010 partial sleep restriction type 1 diabetes insulin sensitivity nine patients glucose infusion 21%
"Hyperglycemic Crises in Adults With Diabetes" "2024" PMC
"Time Lag of Glucose From Intravascular to Interstitial Compartment" "2015"
selection: Prioritized original or authoritative sources for reversed thresholds, Somogyi prevalence/causality, sleep endpoints, menstrual-cycle heterogeneity, DKA definitions and potassium units, overdose cohort/arithmetic, alcohol route/flux, T2D-to-T1D misattribution, CGM transport and TIR/HbA1c estimands.
